first.rationale: Competitive pricing pressure on SMB segment combined with activation decline creates dual urgency. Memory_73 demonstrates promotional pricing drives both acquisition and retention-safe revenue lift in price-sensitive SMB cohorts. Memory_31 shows onboarding simplification alone improved SMB activation durably. Verifying both establishes whether to layer pricing defense with onboarding optimization or pursue pricing as primary lever. Promotional pricing is lower-risk than onboarding changes (which failed to prevent current 4-6% declines) and directly addresses the competitive threat. SMB segment is most vulnerable to competitor entry pricing. Standard experiment allows rapid validation without overcommitting. Enterprise sales assist would miss the active competitive threat in self-serve SMB motion.
